title: Admissibility of evidence.
bodyText: Any evidence gathered at the center shall be gathered in such manner so as to be admissible as evidence at a judicial proceeding.
bodyHtml: [§588-5]  Admissibility of evidence.  Any evidence gathered at the center shall be gathered in such manner so as to be admissible as evidence at a judicial proceeding. [L 1986, c 169, pt of §1]
